# Length-based indicators

## LBIspr

For each gear, `LBIspr()` compares the observed proportion of large fish with
the proportion expected at the reference $F_{\mathrm{SPR}x}$:

1. Equilibrium numbers-at-length at $F_{\mathrm{SPR}x}$, $N^{ref}(L)$, and the
   reference catch composition of gear $g$, $v_g(L) = N^{ref}(L) S_g(L)$ (retained
   bins only, i.e. below the tail cut).
2. Threshold length $L^*_g$: the length at which the cumulative $v_g$ reaches the
   fraction `thresh` (default 0.75) of its total.
3. Reference proportion above the threshold,
   $P^{ref}_g = \sum_{L \ge L^*_g} v_g(L) / \sum_L v_g(L)$ (about $1 -$ `thresh`).
4. Observed proportion in year $y$,
   $P^{obs}_{g,y} = \sum_{L \ge L^*_g} y_{g,y,L} / \sum_L y_{g,y,L}$.
5. Indicator $\mathrm{LBI}_{g,y} = P^{obs}_{g,y}/P^{ref}_g$.

$\mathrm{LBI} = 1$: as many large fish as at the target; $< 1$: fewer, i.e. F above
$F_{\mathrm{SPR}x}$. The threshold lengths are returned as `attr(, "Lref")`.

```{r lbispr}
lbi <- LBIspr(fit, spr = 40, thresh = 0.75)
attr(lbi, "Lref")
plot_LBIspr(fit, thresh = 0.75)
plot_LBIp(fit, year = 2024)
```

## LBImean

`LBImean()` is the model-based analogue of the ICES mean-length indicator
$\bar L/L_{F=M}$: the reference mean length (above `lc`, default the gear's
50% selectivity length) is computed from the fitted model at $F = M$
(`ref = "FM"`) or at $F_{\mathrm{SPR}x}$ (`ref = "spr"`), using the fitted growth
variability and gear selectivity, including domes.

```{r lbimean}
LBImean(fit, ref = "FM")
```

## Indicators and the tail cut

Both indicators use the fit's tail cut by default (`tail_cut = NULL`), so the
indicator and the likelihood use the same bins; `tail_cut = FALSE` uses all bins.

## Check 10: indicators against status

| | |
|---|---|
| **Look for** | LBIspr and SPR/SPR40 telling the same story; similar indicators across gears. |
| **Red flags** | Gears disagreeing strongly (selectivity misfit or sampling); indicator noise much larger than the SPR trend. |
| **Action** | Use the more informative gear; pool gears (`pool` in `flicc.sa()`); smooth in the harvest control rule. |
